name: Focus Modes
author: Casper Bottelet
description: iOS-style Focus modes for your desktop. One toggle applies a whole context — notifications off, distracting sites blocked, noisy apps quarantined, theme switch, keep-awake — and gives every bit of it back when the mode ends.

barWidget.description: Mode chip: shows the active focus mode and its remaining time; click for mode cards

schema.label: Show mode name
schema.description: Show the active mode's name and timer next to the icon (off = icon only)

schema.label: Scroll cycles modes
schema.description: Scrolling on the chip switches to the next/previous mode

schema.label: Notify when a timer ends
schema.description: Send a notification when a timed mode expires and everything is restored
